rows.jyutping: m4 lei5 jan4 gam2 sau6 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone acts without regard for other people's feelings.

example.english: They spoke callously, making the customer feel humiliated.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢唔理人感受咁，搞到個客好難堪。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 m4 lei5 jan4 gam2 sau6 gam3 gaau2 dou3 go3 haak3 hou2 naan4 ham1
